values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Natural Gas Intelligence article from August 2017 says the Permian to Katy pipeline was expected to supply gas for LNG export, power generation, petrochemical use, and Mexico exports. No single terminal is named.

verifications.note: Names the Sempra and Boardwalk Permian-to-Katy pipeline and lists LNG export among its expected uses.

records.researcher_notes: LNG export is one of several demand drivers named, so no terminal is set. The project is cancelled.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A July 2019 trade report says Kinder Morgan planned Permian Pass to carry Permian gas to near the Sabine River, where Cheniere, Sempra, and ExxonMobil with Qatar Petroleum were developing three LNG export terminals. The report names the developers, and the terminal names are matched from them.

verifications.note: Names Permian Pass and says it would extend to near the Sabine River where three LNG export terminals are developed by Cheniere, Sempra, and ExxonMobil/Qatar Petroleum.

records.researcher_notes: The source names the developers, not the terminals, so the three terminal names are my match. The project is cancelled.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Hydrocarbons Technology project page from 2007 says the Point Comfort pipeline would run from the Calhoun LNG terminal to connect to the pipeline system supplying Texas and the Midwest. The terminal was planned as an import plant.

verifications.note: Describes the Calhoun LNG import plant and its Point Comfort pipeline.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A state pipeline lease application from the Alaska Gasline Development Corporation in October 2019 describes the Point Thomson Transmission Line as part of the Alaska LNG project. It would carry gas from Point Thomson to the Alaska LNG gas treatment plant at Prudhoe Bay.

verifications.note: Names the Point Thomson Transmission Line as part of Alaska LNG, ending at the gas treatment plant at Prudhoe Bay.

records.researcher_notes: The sheet already said yes and Alaska LNG Terminal. A source is added.
